## Rationale

close-batch today trusts agent-copied check-run fields; a made-up id closes tdd done. Resolving ids from the store and matching criterion_id, runner, result, and revision closes the forgery hole the differential and mutant spikes found, without inventing a new evidence type.

## Counter-argument

Keeping request-only validation and hardening only the skill prompt would be smaller code change. Issue 3321-class failures show prompt-only gates regress; the hole is already reproducible in this repo.

payload.choice: close-batch resolves check-run ids from the store and matches fields
